The cost jump for account sBGaYvw on 2025-10-20 comes from one instance family, **GWymgjl2rF**. It is used by application qQw on cloud service TwUyi.

- **What changed:** On 2025-10-19 this family cost $57.60 a day, at $0.24 per instance across 10 instances. On 2025-10-20 the price rose to $1.10 per instance, so the family cost $211.20 even though the instance count fell to 8.
- **Likely cause:** Its rows list 2025-10-20 as the expiration date. That suggests a discounted reservation expired and the instances moved to a higher, probably on-demand, rate. The data shows the expiry date and the price change but doesn't say why the price changed.

- **Ruled out:** Instance family wXs6GRnJz0 also looked raised compared with early October. It was flat at $172.34 every day from 10-14 to 10-24, so it isn't part of this anomaly.
